column7: Promise: 'Know every deal. Coach every rep. Forget nothing.'; one memory in three layers. Layer 1 ('What was said') is backed by Built call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries) and documents (Content Library); its email and Slack sources are In build / Planned. In build: 'Memory layers two and three: what calls meant, and what happened next'. Flagged by the Narrative: 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)'.
column8: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: Quantified ('one audit trail'; field signals feeding the next practice cycle; 'a single signal stream') and PitchMonster (role-plays from live Salesforce/Gong deal data; one scorecard across practice and calls) both frame a loop between practice and field data. Regie frames learning per seller (voice, account history); PathFactory frames shared buyer-engagement data for sales and marketing. Difference: none of the five uses 'memory' or claims one memory that connects calls, deals, content and coaching. Hypothesis to test: the practice-to-field loop is becoming the coaching vendors' version of connected intelligence, so a PitchSense memory claim must show more than practice-plus-scores to differ. Test against the Quantified and PitchMonster product pages before using it. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 19, 2026): Built today: layer 1 call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries) and documents (Content Library, practice from your own documents). In build: memory layers two and three and deal links. 'Connecting the dots' is flagged. So the connected-memory promise is not a public claim yet.
